reason: A is marginally better because it frames the distance as an i7-specific optimization and avoids B’s physically questionable claim that shortening stand-off necessarily increases velocity/melting, its arbitrary >20% criterion, and irrelevant citations. However, both proposals inadequately address whether a 300–350 mm stand-off is geometrically feasible inside a 120 mm diameter and unjustifiably transfer M3 nozzle optima to the i7.
